name: ROTT Accelerator
description: The ROTT Accelerator turns your SidecarTridge Multi-device into a graphics card for Rise of the Triad, enabling you to play it at up to 30fps on your Atari ST. Your ST runs the game while the Multi-device takes care of the 3D rendering to give you a fast, playable game. Still experimental. Find out more at neilrackett.com.
